subject: Inbound: per-1M token IO rates + supported model catalog
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@healthspark.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: pricing quick ask: per-1M token IO + model list

Hi Priyom,

Quick intro — I'm Alex, Head of Platform at HealthSpark AI. We're evaluating hosted inference vendors for a pilot later this quarter and need a straightforward baseline to compare unit economics. Could you send your standard per-1M token rates (input vs output split) for the hosted API and a short list of supported models (and any recommended models for chat vs embedding use cases)?

High-level context: we expect ~3M tokens/month initially (mostly chat + some embeddings) and may scale to 50M over 6–12 months if latency and quality look good. We're also interested in any standard discount milestones or commit tiers.

If you have a one-pager or rate sheet, that would be perfect. Thanks —

Alex Moreno
Head of Platform | HealthSpark AI
alex.moreno@healthspark.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@healthspark.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: pricing quick ask: per-1M token IO + model list

Alex — thanks for the note and the context. Helpful. 

Short answer: I attached our standard ratecard and a sample usage CSV to illustrate IO splits. High-level bullets below to get you started:

- Baseline hosted API rates (standard, no commit):
  • Input tokens: $3.50 per 1M tokens
  • Output tokens: $7.00 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $12.00 per 1M embedding tokens (separate SKU)
- Typical chat setup (recommended): a performant 8k-context chat model (gpt-8k-open) for regen/generation and a smaller fast-reply model for short queries.

Standard commit/discount guidance:
- 10–20% off list with a 12-month committed volume (varies by cadence)
- Deeper discounts (20–35%) for multi-year reserved capacity or Dedicated contracts

I've cc'd Ben (pricing lead) to confirm the numbers and Marissa (your potential AE) to help with next steps if you'd like a formal quote. Attached: redwood_standard_ratecard_v1.pdf and a sample usage file that maps IO splits to cost.

Next steps: would you share a ballpark monthly token mix (chat vs embeddings, avg output ratio) so we can run a quick ROI on forecasted volumes? Happy to hop on a 20-min call.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_standard_ratecard_v1.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)
Attachment: healthspark_example_usage.csv (CSV, 6 KB)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@healthspark.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: pricing quick ask: per-1M token IO + model list

Thanks Priyom — got the files and the summary, appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm whether the IO split above refers to billing tokens or model-visible input/output tokens? We need to align with our telemetry.
2) For our pilot, expected mix: ~80% chat (avg 1.2K tokens per session, output about 55% of that), ~20% embeddings (short documents). Estimate ~3M total tokens the first month, skewed to output-heavy usage.
3) Any guidance on which models are considered "redwood-verified" for low-latency chat (aiming <150ms p95 on standard hosted)?

Also — we're sensitive to data residency and would prefer a US-only region for pilot. Is that available on hosted?

If it helps, happy to share a short call — available tomorrow morning PT.

Alex

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@healthspark.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: pricing quick ask: per-1M token IO + model list

Alex — quick clarifications inline: 

1) Billing tokens = model-visible input/output tokens. We'll share our tokenization notes (link below) so you can reconcile with your telemetry.
2) Given your mix and the 55% output ratio, rough landed cost on baseline list = ~$24–28 for 1K chat sessions (this is a ballpark; we'll run a detailed calc once we have exact distributions).
3) "Redwood-verified low-latency" models for hosted: gpt-8k-open (balanced latency/quality), gpt-16k-quant (good cost/latency for longer context), and a smaller reply-optimized family (fast-reply-4k) for short-turn interactions. We maintain perf profiles for each model in the catalog. 

Data residency: yes — US-only hosted regions available for pilot (we can pin region in the request).

I'll follow up with a short spreadsheet that maps your sample usage to monthly cost bands and shows where commit discounts would kick in. Marissa will reach out to schedule a quick scoping call if that works.

Ben Carter
Pricing Strategy Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Related link: https://docs.redwood.ai/tokenization-guide

Date: Fri, 31 May 2029 15:44:00 -0700

Alex — looping in next steps and an attachable quote. 

I've created a short proposal and a scoped pilot quote that reflects a 3M token starting month with options for a 12-month committed path (10% discount) and a pilot-only pay-as-you-go path at list. The proposal includes:
- Line items for input/output per-1M token using the baseline rates Priyom shared
- Embedding SKU and expected embedding unit counts
- Recommended models and a perf/latency note for each (gpt-8k-open recommended for most chat; fast-reply-4k for ephemeral short-turns)
- Pilot region set to US-West (we can change to a specific region if you prefer)

Attachment: redwood_standard_ratecard_v1.pdf (see section 2); proposal doc and a draft quote are available on the shared Drive link I sent earlier.

Would you be available for a 20-min call Monday 10–10:30am PT to review and lock next steps? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite and share a quick cost sheet prior to the call.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
